scope: Sample published source-family forms for Reagan and George H.W. Bush FRUS annotation-sheet review. Use this to preserve real source ecologies and prevent flattening PROFS, W Files, System IV, H-Files, CFPF reels, and public-source families into generic repository paths.

families.display_family: National Archives and Records Administration, College Park, Maryland, PROFS System
required_components_when_present: message identifier or folder subject when present
families.source_or_context: Reagan National Security Policy sources list identifies the PROFS System as a distinct NARA source family.

families.display_family: Ronald Reagan Presidential Library, W Files
do_not_flatten_to: White House Staff and Office Files
families.source_or_context: Reagan National Security Policy sources list treats W Files as a distinct Reagan Library source family.

families.display_family: Ronald Reagan Presidential Library, White House Staff and Office Files, Files of the Executive Secretariat, National Security Council, System IV Intelligence Files
distinguishing_tokens: Files of the Executive Secretariat, National Security Council
required_components_when_present: White House Staff and Office Files
Files of the Executive Secretariat, National Security Council
folder or file title when present
do_not_flatten_to: Reagan Library, White House Staff and Office Files
variant_forms: Reagan Library, White House Staff and Office Files, NSC Executive Secretariat, System IV Intelligence Files
families.source_or_context: Reagan National Security Policy sources list nests System IV Intelligence Files under White House Staff and Office Files, Executive Secretariat, NSC.

families.display_family: George H.W. Bush Presidential Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council Institutional Files (H-Files)
volume_scope: Bush START I national security files
required_components_when_present: subseries or meeting/directive file when present
OA/ID or folder title when present
variant_forms: Bush Library, National Security Council Institutional Files (H-Files)
families.source_or_context: Bush START I sources page identifies National Security Council Institutional Files (H-Files) as critical documentation for NSC, Deputies Committee, and NSD material.

families.display_family: Department of State, Central Foreign Policy File, P Reels, D Reels, and N Reels
volume_scope: Bush START I Department of State cable and memorandum files
required_components_when_present: D, P, or N reel type
telegram number or memorandum locator when present
variant_forms: CFPF D, P, and N reels
families.source_or_context: Bush START I sources page distinguishes D and N cable reels from P reels of memoranda and other paper items.

families.display_family: Published public sources including Public Papers of the Presidents of the United States and the Department of State Bulletin
volume_scope: Reagan Foundations public diplomacy and public statement records
required_components_when_present: speech, statement, testimony, report, or campaign context
archival control copy only when supplied
variant_forms: Public Papers of the Presidents of the United States and Department of State Bulletin
families.source_or_context: Reagan Foundations sources page says much of the volume's documentation was drawn from public sources, especially Public Papers and the Department of State Bulletin.
